name: Infisical
author: infisical

control._comment: Stop order: the app first, then the cache, then the database it talks to. Start is the reverse.

login: `INFISICAL_ADMIN_TOKEN` in `.env` is an instance-admin machine identity for the API/CLI — it is returned exactly once by bootstrap.
description: Self-hosted secrets manager (env vars, API keys, certs) — the machine-side counterpart to vaultwarden. Pinned v0.167.6 + Postgres 16 + Redis 7, loopback-only behind Serve on :8110. First super-admin and org seeded via POST /api/v1/admin/bootstrap, which also returns the instance-admin machine-identity token (saved to .env) and, since v0.162.8, closes public signup. Named volumes infisical-postgres / infisical-redis; marker dir ~/services/infisical. ⚠️ Nothing backs this box up: losing infisical-postgres or ENCRYPTION_KEY loses every stored secret — a dump without the key restores nothing readable. Keep both.
